structuredContent.note: verdict: GO (every check was made and agrees, and nothing needs care), STOP (something is proven not as said: its file or bytes differ from the chain, it is held by another address than the seller's, or it is not a child of the collection named) or NOT SURE (a check could not be made, or something needs care: its code asks a wallet, it loads from outside the chain, a piece it loads is missing, two sites differ, or it names no parent so no collection can be proven). reasons: each with about, mark (ok, stop, care, unknown or info) and says. GO is never advice on its price, or on whether to buy it.
